post.text:
Lake Ōkāreka is the first community group to share its trail information with us for MSC’s Plan My Walk App. We can host the #GIS data for local community groups that do not have their own GIS capability, and MSC automatically pulls it through to appear on Plan My Walk.
planmywalk.nz/tracks/lake-...

source.notes: Public AT Protocol profile and posts can be captured without live-posting side effects.
